dataset.title: Snapshot Japan 2023: the first camera trap dataset under a globally standardised protocol in Japan

focal_biology.selection_basis: named by the published data paper as one of the most commonly observed wild taxa; frozen before eSDM response access
focal_biology.state_rule: trimmed case-insensitive exact age label adult or juvenile; blank and unknown are unlabeled and never reassigned

east_holdout.candidate_rule: consider every strict gap between unique deployment longitudes with at least 50 training deployments west of the gap and at least 12 heldout deployments east of the gap
east_holdout.selection_rule: choose the candidate with the largest longitude gap; ties choose the easternmost cut
east_holdout.integrity: min heldout longitude must be strictly greater than max training longitude

training_camera_roles.assignment: sort training deployment IDs by SHA256(UTF-8 deployment_id), then assign first floor(n/2) to calibrated_presence, next floor((n-first)/2) to state_annotated, remainder to state_composition
